review_topic: Architecture neutrality and valid protocol identities
static_locator: EN-10/EN-22; RM01/RM08/RM25/RM26; conceptual same behaviors without fixed arrays/boolean placeholders
independent_actual_reasoning: WP36 removes implementation-specific storage/array guarantees while keeping encounter query/version/error and PBS grammar contracts. WP37 expresses dormant, persistent-individual and retired states, transient association and roamer-before-Radar ordering without requiring boolean sentinels, fixed arrays or filename organization. Data IDs, result IDs and persisted/migrated semantics remain behavioral inputs.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: A dormant entry can acquire one persistent individual, retain it on revisit, and become retired after the documented outcome. Existing active/retired distinctions and version enumeration versus single-query fallback remain distinguishable.
negative_and_reverse_controls: An implementation with a different internal container but the same externally required states/order remains valid; treating every query as version-fallback or replacing a dormant state with a mandatory true placeholder would reintroduce the defect.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: B08 local architecture contribution only; other assigned contributors and B21 root/global gate remain. Existing audit names used as source locators do not impose clean-room architecture.

review_topic: Partner Radar startup versus subsequent cancellation
independent_actual_reasoning: Radar startup does not test partner presence. A partner is tested later by the normal-land candidate modifier, which cancels the chain and returns without undoing already committed startup charge/statistics. Accepted B06 WP24 §5.4/PT41–63 is an audio contribution, not whole partner/Radar behavior approval.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: With valid land, player at (5,5) on a valid 11×11 fixture, four usable rings, not cycling and battery 50, a present partner still permits startup: battery becomes 0 and use count n+1. A subsequent eligible normal-land candidate cancels the chain and preserves those writes.
negative_and_reverse_controls: The same startup without a partner preserves a normal chain; cycling rejects startup before these commits. Moving the partner rejection to startup would contradict the accepted caller boundary.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: B06 primary / B08 partial contribution. The prior strict pending A034 statistic is not upgraded by candidate or actual R-B08 PASS; parent C and sole registry writer decide any accepted successor.

static_locator: DC-08; BR26; old DC-07/direct tool rows
independent_actual_reasoning: After the two occupied slots gate, Shadow and Undiscovered rejection precede Ditto/gender handling. Passing compatibility yields the documented species/owner factor. Direct generation and direct collection have different count guards and must not inherit periodic compatibility/egg-mark guards. WP34 body remains read-only.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Default non-Shadow DITTO plus PICHU has compatibility 0 and periodic probability 0; DITTO plus Shadow non-Ditto and DITTO plus DITTO also reject. Legal passing non-Ditto parents retain the species/owner factor rule and periodic chance.
negative_and_reverse_controls: A legal DITTO plus breedable non-Ditto passes the prior gates; direct collection with two parents remains a separately guarded path. DC-08’s 1..3 refers to the enclosing factor formula, not a claim that default distinct-species Ditto reaches every factor.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 local correction. Original compatible-parent inputs and direct-tool exceptions are preserved. No inference that the complete direct generation/collection path reuses the compatibility guard.

review_topic: Hatching core writes versus later dynamic form/media effects
static_locator: EG-13/EG-20; existing form data accepted read-only
independent_actual_reasoning: The hatch core does not explicitly change form, but the presentation/resource query can evaluate and commit a dynamic form, clear ability cache, recalculate stats and register seen-form state before ordinary owned/seen-egg writes. Preserved ball/gender/PID/EV/IV/moves guarantees are bounded by the stated WP21 and no-other-write premises. Media failure is later than core commits, with no general rollback or guaranteed music recovery.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Non-Shadow default DEERLING stored form 0, no forced form, steps 1 and month 2, outside battle/storage, valid player/map/dex and ordinary media/skip-nickname path: steps reach 0, hatch core commits, then first scene form read changes form to 1 with setter/dex side effects before the usual owned/seen-egg writes.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Month 1 leaves form 0; forced form or battle/storage early-return context changes the form-query result. Failed media cannot be assumed to undo committed hatch core state. Existing cached shiny state remains, while a first uncached calculation depends on rewritten owner/PID.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 correction, with separate bounded B04 hatching form/media/message actual review required. Conditional media availability is not an observed host or Demo chain.

review_topic: Contest partner double battle versus single override
independent_actual_reasoning: force-single/Safari gates precede partner presence; a legal partner returns true before the one-able-player-member rejection. Contest party restriction to one player member therefore does not imply one foe. The contest override is a one-foe wrapper case; two foes follow ordinary 2v2 preparation/results, and ordinary defeat can heal both participant parties.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Active contest, one able player member after contest restriction, legal partner, force-single false and permitted candidates produces two foes and ordinary 2v2. The single-foe contest override is not called, SportBall count 20 and K remain, and no single wild-end notification is implied. On ordinary normal defeat, partner healing follows the ordinary path.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Removing the partner or forcing single gives one foe and the contest override; ordinary contest budget/result side effects then depend on its normal return. A one-member party must not veto the earlier partner-true branch.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: B12 primary / B08 partial. Accepted B07-V02a/b/c consumer facts are preserved. WP53’s own B12 correction and broader B09 partner obligations remain separate; B04 caller review is bounded to the two registered groups.

independent_actual_reasoning: Revised EN-01/15/16 state the independent contexts and random draws that select their branches. Opportunity, encounter-type selection, candidate selection, wrapper return, ability percentage gate, empty-filter fallback, forced-single veto and partner priority remain distinct stages.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: EN-01 distinguishes non-surfing empty maps (opportunity false), surfing without Water data (opportunity true then empty type), active contest-only table (opportunity true/BugContest), valid direct OldRod request (wrapper normal true), and absent requested table (false with type/original force-single preserved). EN-15 draw 0 filters MAGNETPULL steel candidates and draw 75 retains the table.
negative_and_reverse_controls: A draw 0 with no matching steel candidate retains the original table; ability identity plus steel registration alone does not force filtering. EN-16 force-single true vetoes a partner, whereas a valid partner precedes the one-member rejection when earlier gates pass.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: B08 domain premise contribution only. Broad UI, state and other-owner extensions retain all assigned obligations; root/global C003 remains open.

review_topic: Registry/PBS round trip versus encounter snapshot
independent_actual_reasoning: WP36 §3.2.1 separates registry/edit/save/recompile behavior from the already installed map snapshot. A Land probability 0 is omitted when written to PBS, and recompilation restores default 21 rather than persisting 0. Already accepted WP04 §5/KL22 gives the companion controls and remains unchanged.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Registry Land chance 0: writer omits the chance, subsequent compilation creates Land chance 21. An existing live snapshot remains a distinct earlier copy until an explicit reload.
negative_and_reverse_controls: The same accepted lifecycle design gives OldRod default 0 remaining 0 and explicit Land 70 remaining 70; they need not be duplicated into EN-30. A generic “round trip preserves all chances” claim is invalid.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: B19 primary / B08 partial; B01 lifecycle consumer is preserved, not reaccepted as a new batch. No compiler/editor executed.

review_topic: Editor save/cancel/compile versus installed map data
independent_actual_reasoning: Map setup copies chances/type slots into an installed snapshot. Editor modification/save/cancel and encounter compilation affect the registry/file layer and contain no implicit current-map setup; the debug encounter editor’s fade wrapper does not change this. Reload requires the stated map/version event, and grace reset and accumulator preservation remain distinct.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Save or compile changes the registry/file while the current snapshot remains old. Same-version assignment does not reload. A changed version with valid context performs setup, resets grace to 0 and preserves accumulator 210.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Cancel restores/discards registry edits rather than refreshing installed encounter fields; observing a compiled table identity does not show that current-map runtime readers have adopted it.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: B19 primary / B08 partial snapshot contract. Metrics editor/viewer and other debug lifecycle extensions remain B19 duties. No hidden reload inferred from a generic editor wrapper.

review_topic: Dedicated default roaming graph and conditional coverage
independent_actual_reasoning: The dedicated default KYOGRE roaming area is complete: 2→[21,31], 21→[2,31,69], 31→[2,21,69], 69→[21,31]. Ordinary move from 2 chooses 21/31 with equal probability. The optional jump samples the full four-key set and can stay at 2 or reach 69; the larger global 10-key/9-edge definition is a separate graph.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: With the default dedicated graph and optional-jump branch absent, origin 2 has only 21 or 31 as destinations. An optional branch with its stated draw adds a full-key weighted alternative, including 2 and 69.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Using the global graph for this entry changes its destination support. Setting switch 54 in a synthetic fixture permits the conditional route but does not prove an actual map event or default Demo activation.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: B21 primary / B08 partial. Other C007 named 120 effect / 35 conversion / prefix18 phone / 24-hour / conditional berry extensions remain fully inherited; no cross-domain closure.

independent_actual_reasoning: HUSTLE/PRESSURE/VITALSPIRIT are the 50% take-maximum set; GUTS is outside it and does not consume this ability-percentage draw. The selected initial slot level remains before this override and later flute changes.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Default RATTATA has normal GUTS and hidden HUSTLE. In the valid 11..14 slot, initial selected level 11, ability draw 0 and no flute effects: HUSTLE selects 14; GUTS stays 11 and skips the ability draw.
negative_and_reverse_controls: No matching ability preserves the selected level. A matching ability with the non-hit percentage outcome need not select the maximum. Chinese ability display names cannot substitute GUTS for HUSTLE.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 correction; exact default species/ability and no-flute premises are supported by bounded data text.

review_topic: Header integer conversion versus strict slots and partial registration
independent_actual_reasoning: Header/map/version/chance fields use integer-prefix conversion, while slot weight/levels use strict positive numeric parsing and maximum/minimum checks. Repeated encounter type replaces its slots while omitted probability preserves the earlier header chance. On duplicate converted map/version, the preceding section may already be registered; the error prevents final save, not a transaction rollback.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Header junk/prefix cases convert as documented; repeated Land clears old slots, omitted chance preserves 70 (first omission defaults 21). Converted duplicate map/version is detected after previous-section merge/registration. Slot endpoints 1 and 100 are valid.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Zero weight and zero level reject, 101 and min>max reject. A negative slot weight follows the nonmatching slot-syntax/type-header branch rather than proving the identical zero-weight validation error. A duplicate must not imply that registry writes were rolled back.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 correction; B01 prior accepted parser/lifecycle contribution retained. No parsing or compiler behavior simulated.

independent_actual_reasoning: The step counter is (old+1) modulo 2147483648, rather than saturated. Forced-route/interpreter paths can return before increment. For the eligible path, handler notification follows increment, transfer handling can stop later processing, and menu/event-triggered suppression occurs later; the fixture excludes handlers that rewrite the counter.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Eligible step at 2147483647 wraps to 0 before subscribers; at 2147483646 increments to 2147483647. Menu context still observes the increment/notifications before battle suppression.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Forced-route/interpreter early return does not perform the same increment. A subscriber with its own writes would violate the fixture and cannot be used to refute the stated counter result.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 local correction; accepted B02/WP06 relation retained. These are text-derived designs with no step simulator.

review_topic: Movement opportunity includes contest; Radar land query does not
independent_actual_reasoning: Movement’s land opportunity query can include an active nonempty contest table, whereas the Radar normal-land predicate excludes contest. Surfing gives opportunity even when a Water type is not subsequently available. Opportunity is an early stage, not a promise of battle.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Non-ice land encounter terrain, active contest-only nonempty table, not surfing: opportunity true and encounter type BugContest. Surfing with no encounter tables: opportunity true, later Water/type selection rejects.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Non-surfing with no land/contest/cave opportunity returns false; the same contest-only context does not make the normal-land Radar predicate true. Later probability/allow/override stages can still stop battle.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 correction. Registered B04 contest wrapper scope concerns later caller consequences, not a broad movement or host approval.

review_topic: Full-party population deviation, clamps and rounding
independent_actual_reasoning: The scale hook reads the full party, including eggs/fainted members. Empty/S0 cases use synthetic 1. It uses population deviation, the documented normalized position/weight branch and 0.001/0.999 clamps, then weighted mean, positive half-up rounding/minimum 1, +2 and maximum cap in that order. The random ±2 scale is a later generation stage.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Manual text-derived designs: [5,5] gives base 7 and 3..7 generation range; [10,50] has μ30/σ20, weights .001/.999, weighted mean49.96, rounded50 then +2 gives52 and range48..52; [100,100] caps at100.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Including an egg/fainted member changes the full-party population compared with filtering able members. Empty versus equal-party handling and clamp branches cannot be replaced by sample deviation or by rounding each contribution. No arithmetic/behavior-vector program was run.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: B20 primary / B08 partial mathematical contract; WP77 actual Demo coverage remains B20. The derivation is a static design, not a measured distribution.

review_topic: Temporary and persistent generation, side effects and notification inputs
independent_actual_reasoning: The public species/level wrapper creates temporary candidates before the override. A first roamer creates a separate persistent individual from the incoming candidate’s modified species/level; revisit creates another temporary candidate but reuses the existing persistent individual. Passing an existing individual avoids temporary generation. The post-battle notification uses incoming wrapper species/level, which can differ from the actual persistent combatant.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: The first/revisit/existing-individual paths give generation counts 2/1/0. Under the registered initially uninfected virus-chance65536 fixture, the added virus statistics are +2/+1/0 as applicable. With [10,50] scale and documented 0/4 draws, temporary level48, persistent level52, actual battle52 and single normal-return notification input48 are distinct.
negative_and_reverse_controls: The default small virus chance is nondeterministic and does not imply those statistic totals. Direct species/level entry is not a postcondition-equivalent persistent reuse path; RM25 cleanup-before-missing-notification-properties failure remains. No double generation inferred for existing-individual entry.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 correction. Generation hooks, notification routes and lifecycle/result side effects remain caller-specific; no runtime count or BGM consequence is claimed from the level difference.

review_topic: Pending selection and transient association are both required
independent_actual_reasoning: The roaming calling hook must see both pending persistent selection and this-call transient association, and must not overwrite an earlier handled result. Normal candidate production writes both; that does not prove every artificial, saved or direct state reaches the same branch.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: With an existing individual and otherwise valid direct wrapper fixture, pending selection plus valid transient index activates the override. Pending selection with nil transient index follows the ordinary path.
negative_and_reverse_controls: Nil pending selection rejects even with an index; an already handled calling result remains unchanged. The constructed direct state is a documented counterexample, not a claim of naturally occurring save/load reachability.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 correction, with existing normal-candidate RM08 and handled/cleanup behavior preserved.

review_topic: Validate type before same-value early return
independent_actual_reasoning: Version setter validates Integer before the equality no-op. Same integer version returns without reload; a changed integer loads only when required player/map/encounter context exists. Setup resets grace without resetting accumulated chance. Missing context still writes the requested version.
minimal_positive_or_defect_exposing_desi: Current version1, grace4, accumulator210: assigning integer1 preserves both; changed integer2 with valid context reloads and leaves grace0/accumulator210. With missing necessary context, version changes without setup.
negative_and_reverse_controls: A non-Integer must not evade validation because an equality comparison appears true. The setter result does not establish fallback for every enumeration/query API.
preserved_inputs_and_boundary: Primary B08 correction; C005 snapshot lifecycle remains a distinct partial contribution.
